text:
alex_sales: AuroraPay sent a POC + security pack. Key asks: Okta SAML + SCIM for ~50k users, group->role RBAC sync, DNS TXT domain proofing, soft-delete 90d, and a 2-3 month Dedicated trial quote. Can @priya_se and @marco_sec triage?
priya_se: On it. Quick: do they want delegated admin creation via SCIM for a small group? And NameID=email?
alex_sales: Yes to both. They also need SAML sessions ~12h for overnight jobs.
sara_se: We support SCIM v2 with PATCH and bulk ingest. RBAC done via group mappings (Okta groups -> Redwood roles). We don't auto-promote via SCIM; need explicit mapping. SAML: RSA-SHA256 signatures and optional encrypted assertions supported. Example ACS: `https://api.redwood.com/saml/acs`.
marco_sec: Compliance: SOC2 Type II + ISO available, EU residency optional, BYOK supported. Soft-delete + tombstone for 90 days supported; need addendum for retention policy. Long sessions increase risk, recommend refresh-token flow for programmatic jobs.
alex_sales: Pricing ask: steady 4k auth checks/s, bursts to 8k. Trial then 1yr commit. Any sizing/ballpark?
sara_se: Ballpark: 2 GPU-equivalent steady, autoscale/burst credits to cover peaks. Finance to confirm exact quote.
ticket-bot: ticket created POC-812 (AuroraPay auth/provisioning) assigned to @sara_se due in 3 business days.
priya_se: I'll prepare an Okta app template + attribute mapping (`email`, `givenName`, `familyName`, `groups`, `employeeNumber`). Ask them to attach a sample SCIM export CSV so we can size ingest.
sara_se: I'll add a short runbook and `curl` examples for SCIM bulk sync: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Bulk -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"Operations":[...]}'`.
alex_sales: Thanks. Scheduling kickoff tomorrow 11am PT — who can join?
priya_se: I can.
marco_sec: I'll join with SOC2 slides.
alex_sales: Great, I'll share questionnaire to the ticket and the calendar invite.
